description: Defines the interface for PacFileFetcher, an asynchronous component responsible for fetching proxy auto-configuration (PAC) scripts, including methods for initiating fetches, cancelling, and managing request context.

classes.name: PacFileFetcher
classes.description: An interface class for fetching PAC scripts asynchronously, with methods to fetch, cancel, and manage request context.

methods.name: Fetch
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous fetch of a PAC script from a specified URL, with callback handling for completion and error codes.

methods.name: GetRequestContext
methods.description: Returns the URLRequestContext used for downloads, or nullptr if unavailable.

methods.name: OnShutdown
methods.description: Fails ongoing and future fetch requests, and cleans up request context.
